items:
Shear Elegance by Royal Destinations

Location: Blue Mountain Beach
Address: 337 Blue Mountain Rd, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459

Details:
Searching for a 30A vacation rental that is located just steps from the beach access, has a large private pool, and an outdoor entertainment area? Look no further than Shear Elegance! This Blue Mountain vacation rental offers guests the ability to enjoy as much fun in the sun as possible. Guests of Shear Elegance can spend long days at the beach access (located just 100 feet away) and afterwards enjoy the backyard oasis by taking a refreshing dip in the private pool. Those searching for 30A vacation rentals with a private pool will not be disappointed as this home is 14’ x 28’ and can be heated for an additional cost. With the space to accommodate up to 20 people, this luxury 30A rental is perfect for extended family or multiple families traveling together. Boasting 3 living rooms, 6 bedrooms, 5 full baths, and 1 half bath, guests have plenty of space to gather together but also have the option to retreat to their own rooms surrounded by coastal elegant decor by Urban Grace interior designs.

If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental.

Home Highlights:
-Distance to Beach Access: 100 Feet (1 Minute Walk)
-Parking Spaces: 5 Spaces in Driveway
-Dining Accommodations: Table Seating for 12, Bar Seating for 6
-Washer/Dryer
Coffee Maker Available
-Gas Grill Available (Propane Provided)
-Private Heated Pool: 14’ x 28’
*Pool heat is available for an additional $330 (pre-tax)
*The pool heater does require 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees.
*The jetted spa, isn't a hot tub. If pool is heated, the jetted spa will be the same temperature.
*Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay.

Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements:
6 Bedrooms / 5.5 Bathrooms / Sleeps 20

First Floor:
-Bedroom 1: King Bed with Shared Bath (Shower/Tub Combo)
-Bedroom 2: Queen/King Bunk with Shared Bath (Shower/Tub Combo)
-Bedroom 3: Two Queen/Queen Bunks with Shared Bath (Shower)
-Bedroom 4: King Bed with Private Bath (Shower)
-Two Living Areas
-Laundry Room

Second Floor:
-Bedroom 5: King Bed with Private Bath (Shower)
-Bedroom 6 (Master): King Bed with Private Bath (Soaking Tub and Shower)
-Half Bath
-Kitchen / Living Area / Dining Area

Amenities Include:
-6 Adult Bikes

Please Note:
*Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival.
*The outdoor fire pit is not operational or available for guest use.

Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

reviews.author: karen l.
reviews.label: Excellent

responses.response:
Karen, thank you for taking the time to share such thoughtful feedback about your stay at Shear Elegance. We're glad our team was able to respond quickly when hiccups arose, and we truly appreciate you recognizing the care that went into the home’s décor and details.

You’re absolutely right that normal wear can show up over time, but it’s still our responsibility to keep the home looking and feeling its best. We’re already sharing your notes about the stained/worn areas with our home care team so we can address what can be improved or refreshed.

Thank you for the feedback on the mattresses, especially in the lower front master. We understand mattress comfort can be a personal preference, and we’ve shared your comments with our team for review as we continue to make improvements where possible.

Thank you again for highlighting what you loved, especially the kitchen and how well stocked it was. We’d love the chance to host your family again.

reviews.text: There were a few issues but Royal Destinations always responded quickly. Sadly, with any rental, time and wear take its toll on furniture. Shear Elegance was decorated beautifully with attention to detail. The rugs and couches were clean but some were stained and showed wear. The only real complaint was from all the adults about how the mattresses slept…extremely soft. The lower front Master had the most uncomfortable mattress. The kitchen was to die for and extremely well stocked. It was a perfect space for our family.

responses.response:
Thank you so much for sharing your experience! We’re thrilled to hear that the home was the perfect fit for your family and provided plenty of space to gather, laugh, and make lasting memories. We love that you enjoyed the convenient beach access, private pool, and well-equipped kitchen—it sounds like the house truly set the stage for a wonderful getaway.

We appreciate your note about the Wi-Fi and will review it with our team to see where improvements can be made. We’re so glad this didn’t take away from your time here and that the location, amenities, and comfort all came together to create a great stay.

It was our pleasure to host your family of 13, and we can’t wait to welcome you back for your next Florida vacation!

reviews.text: This property checked all the boxes and did a great job for our family. We come to Florida every other year to have time with just our family to laugh and make memories. The property was beautiful and access to the beach was perfect just across the street and are part of the beach was not as crowded. Location for things to do and places to eat, couldn’t have been better. The only difficult part was Wi-Fi is a little spotty, but you’re going on vacation so we can deal with that. It was definitely worth that for everything we got. Love the pool and the kitchen was phenomenal. Tons of room for our large family of 13 all ages. We will definitely be coming back.
